create_calendar: create a new calendar for a user with a name, color, and optional access grants using Calendars.insert_new_calendar
get_calendars_by_user: get all owned and shared calendars for a user using Calendars.get_calendars_by_user with access grant filtering
create_calendar_event: create a new calendar event with title, start time, end time, attendees, and optional recurrence rule using CalendarEvents.insert_new_event
get_events_by_range: fetch calendar events visible to a user within a date range including owned, shared, and attended events using CalendarEvents.get_events_by_range
update_rsvp: update an attendee RSVP status for a calendar event using CalendarEventAttendees.update_rsvp with accepted, declined, or tentative status
